connector.name: Swsd
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for SolarWinds Service Desk: tickets, knowledge base, and the service catalog.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package swsd-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mikimatsub account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SWSD_TOKEN
env.description: SolarWinds Service Desk admin token (JWT). Generate in the SWSD UI: Setup -> Users & Groups -> Users -> [your user] -> Actions -> Generate JSON Web Token. Service Desk administrator rights required.

env.name: SWSD_BASE_URL
env.description: SWSD API base URL. US tenants: https://api.samanage.com (default). EU tenants: https://apieu.samanage.com.

env.name: SWSD_PROFILE
env.description: Tool registration profile: 'triage' (14 read-heavy tools), 'agent' (37 default), 'knowledge' (15 KB-author), 'operations' (64 ITSM operations tools), 'full' (66 every tool).

env.name: SWSD_WRITE_MODE
env.description: Write safety mode: 'live' calls SWSD normally; 'dry-run' returns write payload previews without sending writes; 'disabled' rejects write tools.
